# Open Educational Resources / Open Source Physics @ Singapore

> > Singapore's national platform for interactive physics and mathematics simulations supporting MOE's EdTech Masterplan 2030 and inquiry-based learning

OER@SG and OSP@SG provide open-source educational simulations built with EJS (Easy JavaScript Simulations) for physics, chemistry, and mathematics. The platform has won multiple UNESCO and MOE Innergy Awards for innovative use of technology in education, supporting Singapore's digital learning transformation.

## Awards and Recognition

- [2022 Publication - UNESCO King Hamad Bin Isa Al-Khalifa Prize](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/awards/1365-2022-publication-innovative-use-of-technology-in-education-winning-projects-of-unesco-s-king-hamad-bin-isa-al-khalifa-prize): UNESCO King Hamad Prize publication featuring OSP@SG winning project
- [Gold Innergy Award 2016 - Open Source Physics](https://www.sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/awards/439-ministry-of-education-gold-innergy-award-2016-hq): Gold Innergy 2016: OSP@SG interactive simulations for MOE
- [Gold Innergy Award 2012 - Gravity Physics by Inquiry](https://www.sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/awards/341-innergy-award-gold-2012-gravity-physics-by-inquiry): Gold Innergy 2012: inquiry-based gravity physics solar system simulations
- [2024 Silver Innergy Award - Inquiry-Based Math Resources](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/awards/1264-2024silverinnergy): Silver Innergy 2024: inquiry-based math resources for UNESCO 2030 goals
- [2022 Bronze Innergy Award - RPA using TagUI for SLS](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/awards/1150-2022-bronze-innergy-award-2021-submission-free-robotic-process-automation-rpa-using-tagui-ai-singapore-project-for-student-learning-space-sls): Bronze Innergy 2022: RPA using TagUI for Student Learning Space automation
- [Bronze Innergy Award 2019 - DIY Mobile Apps](https://www.sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/awards/889-innergy-award-2019-submission-do-it-yourself-diy-android-and-ios-apps): Bronze Innergy 2019: DIY mobile apps for Android and iOS platforms
- [2022 National Day Awards - 25 Years Long Service Medal](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/awards/1149-2022-national-day-awards-recipients-25-years-of-long-service-medal): 2022 National Day Award: Long Service Medal for 25 years in MOE

## Simulation Authoring Tools

- [Easy JavaScript/Java Simulation Authoring and Modeling Tool](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/135): EJS simulation authoring tool for creating interactive physics models
- [SSTRF Research - Math Learning Apps](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/449): SSTRF research on mobile math learning apps for Singapore curriculum

## Interactive Simulations and Projects

- [Moment of Balancing Beam - Modeling Instruction](https://www.sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/965-balancingact): Balancing beam simulation using Modeling Instruction by Boon Chien Yap
- [Tracker Video Analysis - Cart on Inclined Plane](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/459-cartsteepslope): Tracker video analysis: cart dynamics on inclined plane by RGS
- [WebEJS Workshop - 21CC Navigator Gem Matching Game](https://www.sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/1227): WebEJS workshop project: 21CC Navigator card matching game by Joseph Ang
- [WebEJS Workshop - Music Playing Game](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/1241): WebEJS workshop: interactive music playing game with resonator bells

- [REV2021 Online Workshop - Remote Engineering and Virtual Labs](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/events/1037-20210224-26-remote-engineering-and-virtual-instrumentation-rev2021-february-24-26-2021-online-worksup): REV2021 online workshop: remote engineering and virtual labs with EJSS
- [AST Chemistry Learning Day - Interactive Simulations](https://www.sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/events/1000-20200819-chemistry-learning-day-c1-sharing-by-zenia): AST Chemistry Learning Day: interactive simulations for chemical reactions
- [Chemistry Learning Day Event - Acids and Bases](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/events/1000-20200819-chemistry-learning-day-c1-sharing-by-zenia): Chemistry Learning Day event: acids, bases, and balancing equations
